name: skylark_get_flight_gate
intent: Find the departure gate for a SkyLark flight to a given city
description: Open My Trips in SkyLark Air, select the trip to the requested destination city, and read the departure gate from the trip details screen.
patterns: What gate does my flight leave from
What gate is my flight departing from
Find the departure gate for my flight
What is the gate for my flight

inputs.name: trip_city
inputs.description: The destination city of the flight, shown in the goal and matched against the trip rows in My Trips.

steps.intent: Tap the My Trips button to open the trips list.
Tap the trip row for {{trip_city}} in the list.
